Answer: F) Subcutaneous emphysema, pneumoperitoneum, and anterior pneumomediastinum delineated by xiphoid attachment  
Reason: The lateral CXR (Figure 1b) shows radiolucent gas tracking along the anterior chest wall and extending below the diaphragm into the peritoneal cavity (arrows), with gas sharply demarcated at the xiphoid process—consistent with anterior pneumomediastinum and pneumoperitoneum; subcutaneous emphysema is also visible in the soft tissues.
